name: only keeps one kind and drop removes one kind
about: only note passes notes, note offs included, and nothing else, while drop clock removes the clock and passes every other kind, transport included.
notes: Kinds are read from the status byte as in midi-kinds.mjs: 8n and 9n note, Bn cc, En bend, Dn touch, F8 clock, FA transport.
l1 to notes is only note. l2 to quiet is drop clock. Outputs follow link order, notes before quiet.
t 0: 90 3C 64 is a note. Both pass.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 1: B0 01 40 is a cc, dropped by only note. quiet passes it.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 2: F8 is clock, dropped by both, by only note because it is not a note and by drop clock because it is.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 3: E0 00 40 is a bend, dropped by only note. quiet passes it.
t 4: 80 3C 00 is a note off, which is a note, so only note passes it. A note filter that kept the note on and dropped its release would leave it stuck. quiet passes it.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 5: FA (start) is transport, not clock. only note drops it, drop clock passes it. A drop clock that took every F8..FF byte would lose it.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 6: D0 20 is channel touch, dropped by only note. quiet passes it.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l3 asks for only notes, a kind nobody named, and is refused bad-args.
